candidates.description: Permits the Parent Borrower, upon consummating a Material Acquisition and making a timely election, to increase the maximum permitted Consolidated Total Leverage Ratio by up to 0.50x for four consecutive fiscal quarters following the acquisition.
Caps the increased (stepped-up) Consolidated Total Leverage Ratio at no more than 6.00 to 1.00 regardless of the scheduled step-up amount.

Requires the Parent Borrower to deliver notice of its step-up election no later than the earlier of 30 days after consummating the Material Acquisition or the date financial statements for that fiscal quarter are due under Section 6.1(a) or (b).
